speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child presenting with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mucous membranes, and small red spots on your skin. To understand what is happening, do you bruise very easily with even minor bumps, and do your gums bleed when you brush?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The clinical picture of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, petechiae, and easy bruising in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of ITP. Please request a complete blood count (CBC) with platelet count and a peripheral blood smear to confirm the diagnosis.
